title: release(v18): the version pass now rewrites `skills/*/SKILL.md` (PR #22692's `check-skill-compatibility-version.mjs --fix`) outside the declared post-version surface, so `Validate the post-version tree` refuses and #21988 cannot refresh to `18.0.0-next.0`
body:
Unblocks: #22659 (`@objectstack/skills` installable from npm needs the first publish), #22085 (the version-PR lane) and the v18 `next` line.

Filing gate ①: a defect with a named landing point and a measured cost. Filed and graded by the triage seat (seat post #6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`) from the scheduled release run's log. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:devx` lane, which owns `.github/workflows/release.yml` and the version-PR lane (#22085).

## What is measured

- **Scheduled `release.yml` run `38212422606`** (2026-10-12T06:25Z), job `Version PR maintenance` (`114689361348`), step `Validate the post-version tree`, on `main` with the v18 landing page now present (PR #22928). The previous gate, `check:release-notes`, passes.
- It refuses with the treadmill guard:
  - ten lines `unexpected: skills/<name>/SKILL.md` (`objectstack-ai`, `-api`, `-automation`, `-data`, `-formula`, `-i18n`, `-platform`, `-query`, `-ui`, `-upgrade`);
  - then "the version pass wrote outside the reviewed post-version surface (paths above). … a new version-time output must arrive together with the gate that judges it. Add the surface to the declaration its rewriter reads, and its gate …".
- **The writer:** the root `version` script now ends with `node scripts/check-skill-compatibility-version.mjs --fix`, added by PR #22692 (`bf515e724d`, 2026-10-11, `Fixes #22658`). Its `--fix` rewrites every published SKILL.md's compatibility majors and `metadata.version` from the workspace version.
- **What the guard reads:** `Validate the post-version tree` filters the moved paths through a fixed pattern plus three resolved lists:
  - `SURFACE_LIST` (the docs surfaces);
  - `TEMPLATE_LIST` (`stampedPaths()` from `sync-template-versions.mjs`);
  - `INDEX_LIST` (`syncedPaths()` from `sync-release-index-currency.mjs`).
  - The skill rewriter exports no such list, so its writes read as unexpected.
- **Cost:**
  - #21988 stays at `17.8.0` and cannot refresh to `18.0.0-next.0`. Red there publishes nothing.
  - This is now the only failing gate on the version lane I found in this run.
  - The guard's own header says `cut-rc.yml` applies the same four filters, so an RC cut would refuse the same way.

## Direction (the guard's own remedy)

- `check-skill-compatibility-version.mjs` exports the paths its `--fix` writes, as a function derived from the same walk `--fix` uses, like `stampedPaths()` and `syncedPaths()`.
- `release.yml`'s `Validate the post-version tree` resolves it as a fourth list, with the same two refusals as its siblings (could not resolve; resolved EMPTY). `cut-rc.yml` reads it the same way.
- **The gate that judges the stamps:** the same script without `--fix`. Confirm it runs in the post-version content half; if it does not, add it there in the same change, because the guard says the surface "must arrive together with the gate that judges it".
- ⛔ No regex widening such as a `^skills/` pattern. ⛔ Do not drop `--fix` from the `version` script. ⛔ Do not hand-edit any SKILL.md stamp.

## Done when

- The next scheduled `release.yml` run passes `Validate the post-version tree`, and #21988 refreshes to `18.0.0-next.0`. The holder records the run on #22085.
- A self-test or pin shows that a SKILL.md write outside the exported list is still refused.

## Grade (triage)

`tooling` · `bug` · `priority:p1` (release-first: 「发版本优先的都p1」) · `domain:devx` · `target:v18` · `area:devpath` · `pm:queue`. `Clause-②: no`.
